characterPaths.label: Vanguard
characterPaths.description: You are a heavily armored, frontline protector. You’re most comfortable standing firmly between your vulnerable companions and the sharp points of enemy weapons.

characterPaths.label: Prowler
characterPaths.description: You’re an expert hunter and thrive at range. Your enemies are your prey, and you stalk them relentlessly, striking at their weak points. You’re accompanied by a fiercely loyal animal. Companions cannot be attacked; they’re mechanically a part of the Prowler.
